many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only

def transform(grid):
    g = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(g), len(g[0])
    marked = [(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c] == 7]
    r0=min(r for r,c in marked); c0=min(c for r,c in marked)
    pattern=[(r-r0,c-c0) for r,c in marked]
    ph=max(r for r,c in pattern)+1; pw=max(c for r,c in pattern)+1
    for r in range(h-ph+1):
        for c in range(w-pw+1):
            if all(g[r+dr][c+dc] == 0 for dr,dc in pattern):
                for dr,dc in pattern: g[r+dr][c+dc]=7
    return g
PY

def transform(grid):
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    # marker color is the non-binary value; use its cells as a stencil and
    # paint every all-zero placement of that stencil.
    color=next(v for row in g for v in row if v not in (0,1))
    pts=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c]==color]
    r0=min(r for r,c in pts); c0=min(c for r,c in pts)
    pts=[(r-r0,c-c0) for r,c in pts]
    ph=max(r for r,c in pts)+1; pw=max(c for r,c in pts)+1
    original=[row[:] for row in g]
    for r in range(h-ph+1):
        for c in range(w-pw+1):
            if all(original[r+dr][c+dc]==0 for dr,dc in pts):
                for dr,dc in pts: g[r+dr][c+dc]=color
    return g
PY
